https://dev.roost.ai.core_purpose: The site provides automated testing environments for software development teams to streamline deployment processes and minimize manual intervention.
business_requirements: Users must be able to create and configure isolated testing environments for software applications.
Users must be able to integrate the platform with their existing CI/CD pipelines.
Users must be able to view real-time status updates and logs of testing environments.
Users must be able to manage access control and permissions for team members within the platform.
Users must be able to clone or replicate testing environments for parallel testing or debugging purposes.
Users must be able to schedule automated environment setups based on predefined triggers or timelines.
Users must be able to delete or shut down testing environments once they are no longer needed.
